description: Start a pane's program again in the same pane: the command it was started with (or command), in its starting directory (or cwd). A pane whose program is still running is refused unless kill is true, which ends that program first.

command.description: Shell command to run instead of the one the pane was started with.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or `~/…`. Defaults to the pane's starting directory.

kill.description: End the pane's program first when it is still running (default false).

pane_id.description: Pane id, the same as before.
